label: baseline-2026-11-08

methodology.population: available == true; inventory.public_market_eligible and listing_style; public merchant flags; Birkin/Kelly; finite positive USD asks
methodology.merchant_gate: Config.MERCHANTS: active and generated_pages and not regional_only; unknown sources allowed as on public routes
methodology.currency: Normalized/display USD, including converted asks; missing currency defaults to USD as in price_history_service. FX movements can appear as drops.
methodology.n: Priced active listing documents, not unique physical bags; cross-merchant duplicates are not removed. POA/unpriced excluded from n and price statistics; reported separately.
methodology.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q (type 7); median is the ordinary sample median. Filters match widget; its nearest-index percentile estimator differs.
methodology.drop_window: UTC calendar-day window (as_of minus days, as_of], not a rolling-hour window. Compare observed USD pairs only when the earlier day is on/after the window boundary. Append today's live ask as in price_history_service.
methodology.drop_count: Distinct currently priced active listings with at least one observed decrease; a later increase does not erase an earlier decrease. History prices use price_history_service whole-dollar normalization.
methodology.median_drop_pct: Per listing, largest single observed-pair decrease in the window; median of these positive percentages across listings that dropped. Not cumulative discount or net change.
methodology.drop_denominators: pct_of_priced uses n; pct_of_comparable uses listings with at least one within-window pair. No observed drop does not establish an unchanged ask when history is incomplete.
methodology.full_window_history: Earliest valid observed day is on/before window boundary; the latest ask is appended today. Observation gaps remain possible.
methodology.comparison: Repeated cross-sections, not a matched-basket index or causal estimate of Black Friday; inventory composition, condition, leather and FX can change.
methodology.recorder_scope: Baseline history was captured by a capped Birkin-only recorder. All-style capture is prepared for the November 9 deployment, not assumed already active. No-history rates are null.
methodology.material_cut: At least 3% between successive daily observations in the window. Use positive source_price in matching source_currency on both observations, otherwise USD fallback when source metadata is missing. Conflicting/changing explicit source currencies are incomparable; no cross-currency native comparison.
methodology.material_basis: Each listing counts once: native if any material native pair exists, otherwise USD-only. Median uses the largest native material pair when present, otherwise largest USD-only material pair. USD-only counts can still include FX; threshold is not proof of a seller promotion.

caveats: Asking prices, not completed sales; not evidence of returns or a holiday discount.
Current survivors only; sold/delisted listings excluded without inferring a sale.
Coverage is observational and can miss intraday changes, coupons, checkout-only offers and unrecorded cuts.
USD conversions can move without a merchant changing the native ask.
Tax, shipping, duties and buyer-specific final costs are excluded.
Not affiliated with Hermès; no stock, authenticity or investment guarantee.

publication.price_basis: advertised asking prices, not completed sales
